description: This Java class UpdateFileParser parses an XML file named update.rdf to extract module update information such as module ID, current version, and download URL. It uses XML parsing libraries to interpret the RDF content and contains logic to handle different configuration versions.

classes.name: UpdateFileParser
classes.description: A class that parses an RDF XML file to obtain module update details.

methods.name: UpdateFileParser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with content of the update.rdf file.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the RDF XML content and extracts module update information, handling different config versions.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Utility method to extract text content of a specified tag from an XML element.

methods.name: validConfigVersions
methods.description: Returns a list of valid config versions for the RDF file.

methods.name: getDownloadURL
methods.description: Returns the download URL from the RDF.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the module ID from the RDF.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version identified in the RDF.
